name: Healthie
summary: All-in-one practice management and EHR for health, wellness and nutrition providers: scheduling, telehealth, secure messaging, billing and a branded client portal — plus a full API (GraphQL + webhooks) for automation. Built to scale with group practices.
best_for: growing group practices (10+ clinicians) in health, wellness and nutrition that need multi-provider scheduling, telehealth and a real API to automate operations
skip_if: you're a solo practitioner or tiny team who wants the simplest, cheapest setup — SimplePractice is easier and lighter for that
honest_knock: Two honest limits: it's pricier than alternatives with thin mid-tier options, and several users report slow customer service (sometimes a week or more to reply). It really only pays off at scale — solo or tiny practices get more value, more simply, elsewhere.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Core · billed monthly — $18 is the yearly rate
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-08-17 and re-read unchanged 2026-09-28 on their own pricing page; yearly billing saves 10%) The entry tier is far lower than most summaries suggest: Core is $19.99/mo billed monthly or $18 billed yearly, Essentials $49.99 or $45, Plus $129.99 or $115, and Group $149.99+ or $135+ per month. Enterprise scales above that. Two costs sit outside the tier and matter for a practice: additional team members are $50 per clinician per month, and the ClaimMD billing integration starts at $30 a month. There is a 14-day free trial, and full API access sits above the standard group tier. The same page, read 28 September 2026, offers the 14-day trial on the Plus plan, lists DoseSpot ePrescribing at $40 per clinician a month with no setup fee, card payments at 2.9% + $0.30 and API access as an add-on with additional fees. It is not consistent on one add-on: the plan table puts ClaimMD at from $30 a month, while the integrations section describes it as from $25 a month plus a $50-$100 setup fee.
